# Status History (Auto-Generated)

This directory is generated and committed by the [Upptime](https://github.com/upptime/upptime)
monitor, driven by [`.github/workflows/upptime.yml`](../.github/workflows/upptime.yml) and
configured in [`.upptimerc.yml`](../.upptimerc.yml).

Every 5 minutes (and on push to `main`), the workflow checks each site listed under `sites` in
`.upptimerc.yml` — Stellar Horizon (testnet and mainnet), the ILN Soroban contract endpoint, the
ILN frontend, and the ILN docs site — and commits the results back to this repository:

| File | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| `summary.json` | Aggregated uptime and response-time summary for every monitored site |
| `<site-slug>.yml` | Latest check result for one site (status, response code, response time, timestamps) |

## Do not hand-edit

These files are overwritten by the next scheduled Upptime run. Manual edits will be silently lost
and do not reflect real monitoring data. To change what is monitored, edit the `sites` list in
[`.upptimerc.yml`](../.upptimerc.yml) instead — the workflow picks up the new configuration on its
next run.
